body.label: Target
body.html: One creature within weapon range and line of sight.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On a success, deal 1 weapon damage. Ignore 1 Defense from cover if the target is Locked by you.

surges.html: Move up to 2 units before or after resolving this Action.
On a success, the target cannot make Reactions against your next Ballistics Action this turn.

rider.title: TARGETING
rider.html: If the target is Locked by you, your Lock persists until the end of your next turn even if the target is briefly outside line of sight.
